$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard on the hard ride (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard)
pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays two Spectral
Lantern Bombs and the Hoard is never empty; then the Horseman's flaming breastplate, which pays
from here and nowhere else; then the rest of the Flaming Hallowed set's pieces (the Burning Jack
Helm, his flaming gauntlets and greaves, and the Flaming Jack Shield) at twice the normal Hoard's
odds; the last two are the tombstone and the ruins lantern from his graveyard, which no recipe
makes. The normal Hoard is Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json beside this file, and the Almanac's
Hoard grid (ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve.json) lists what both pay, so
change them together. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
